what: Manual-only write-params failure can skip flag recovery
scenario_or_breakage: The current recovery guard is keyed only on partition_requested or brainstorm_requested. If write-run-params fails during a --manual-only run and the plan only adds manual_gate_b inside the merge expression, the block will not run, run-params.json can omit manual_gate_b, and Gate B will default to auto-apply despite the operator opting out.
suggested_fix: Revise the plan to explicitly update both outer recovery conditions and the no-jq warning path to include manual_requested, merge manual_gate_b alongside the other booleans, and add a manual-only recovery assertion.

what: Stale no-auto-apply contracts remain outside the edited Gate B paragraph
scenario_or_breakage: Several loaded prompt/reference surfaces still say reviewer suggestions are never auto-applied, plan revision is per explicit user choice, or findings apply only if the user chooses. After the proposed default flip, these contradictions can cause the orchestrator or reviewer-facing templates to preserve the old manual-only behavior.
suggested_fix: Expand the plan to update all adjacent no-auto-apply/user-choice wording, not only approval-gates Invariant #4 and SKILL Step 3.5; grep for explicit user choice, only if the user chooses, auto-applied, and never silently applies.

what: Public skill catalog update misses docs/skills.md
scenario_or_breakage: The plan conditionally updates README when /design flags are enumerated, but docs/skills.md also enumerates the same /design arguments and is linked from README. Leaving it stale means consumers see --manual in one catalog surface but not the detailed skill catalog.
suggested_fix: Add docs/skills.md to the plan with the same argument-hint and one-line --manual semantics update as README.
